verdict.rationale: Usage metering is a fair question for a billing and invoicing product, so the axis applies. The evidence covers invoices, recurring invoices, a customer portal for past transactions, statements and reports, but nothing on current-cycle usage metering, real-time accrued cost, or usage thresholds and alerts. The customer portal and transaction statements are adjacent features showing billed history, not live usage, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, customers and my team can see current-cycle usage and accrued cost in real time, with thresholds and alerts before an invoice surprises anyone
